findings.title: Opening copy uses unexplained jargon
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: It sounds technical and makes a simple present feel complicated before I have even started.

findings.title: Printed price is not visible before creation
findings.evidence: The page says “Printed hardcovers shipped across the UK” and offers “See pricing,” but shows no actual hardback price.
findings.why: I want to know the full delivered price up front so I am not surprised later.

findings.title: Phone navigation is cramped
findings.evidence: “How it works,” “Pricing,” and “Log in” are squeezed across the top of the narrow screen, with “How it works” wrapping onto two lines.
findings.why: The wrapped nav looks untidy and makes the header controls less predictable under my thumb.

findings.title: Fields have no visible labels
findings.evidence: [5] textbox (no label) placeholder "Email"; [6] textbox (no label) placeholder "Password"
findings.why: The placeholders are easy to understand here, but once I start typing, I may forget what each box is for.

findings.title: Unexplained technical error on a successful login
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I don't know whether my family details are safe or whether continuing could cause problems later.

findings.title: Navigation wraps awkwardly on a phone
findings.evidence: The links “How it works”, “My books”, and “Log out” are split across multiple lines and visually crowded.
findings.why: The wrapping looks untidy and makes it slightly harder to work out which words belong together.

findings.title: Relationship is preselected before a character is entered
findings.evidence: [11] Relationship is selected: “Grandparent” while [10] “Who else is in the story?” is empty
findings.why: I nearly assumed the site had already guessed Meera’s relationship, and I might accidentally include a grandparent.

findings.title: Only one other-character appearance field is provided
findings.evidence: [10] “Who else is in the story?” has no matching appearance field, while [9] asks “What do they look like?” only for the child
findings.why: Meera’s yellow dress and tiny pigtails are part of the memory and I would like the story to include them.

findings.title: Lexile labels need plain-language help
findings.evidence: “Lexile BR–200L”
findings.why: I know this is for a five-year-old, but I am not sure whether “BR–200L” is actually the best beginner choice.

findings.title: Mobile navigation wraps into separate lines
findings.evidence: The top navigation visibly shows “How it works”, “Pricing”, “My books”, and “Log out” across crowded lines.
findings.why: It looks untidy and makes the header taller than it needs to be on my phone.

findings.title: Header navigation wraps and reads as broken sentences
findings.evidence: The top shows “How it StoryHearth works,” “Pricing,” “My books,” and “Log out” on separate, awkwardly aligned lines.
findings.why: It makes the page look unfinished and makes the links harder to scan with one thumb.

findings.title: Footer text is very faint
findings.evidence: “Privacy Terms Contact © 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” appears in extremely light grey on the pale background.
findings.why: I can barely see the privacy, terms, and contact links, and privacy matters when a child's photo could be involved.

findings.title: Photo upload gives no privacy reassurance
findings.evidence: The page asks for “a clear photo of your child's face” but gives no nearby explanation of how the image is stored, used, or deleted.
findings.why: I might want to upload a photo, but I need to know what happens to my child's image.

findings.title: Generated style does not match the selected style
findings.evidence: The selection screen showed “Crayon — like a child drew it,” but the generated cover says “Illustration style: Pop-art comic.”
findings.why: I chose crayon specifically for Aarav’s birthday, and the generated result looks different, so I can’t trust the other choices were applied.

findings.title: Generated title contains a spelling error
findings.evidence: The cover and page heading both say “The Magical Adventrue of Aarav.”
findings.why: It is prominently printed on a birthday present and makes the book look unfinished.

findings.title: Paid regeneration is prominent without clarifying what changes
findings.evidence: [8] “Regenerate entire book – $4.99”
findings.why: I would need to know whether this replaces the whole book, whether it is one-off or subscription-like, and whether the result would be better before spending anything.

findings.title: Next-page control lacks a text label
findings.evidence: [7] button “›”
findings.why: I recognise the arrow, but a text label would be quicker and clearer while using one thumb.

findings.title: Top navigation wraps awkwardly on a phone
findings.evidence: The header visibly breaks “How it works” and “My books” across lines and overlaps the StoryHearth wordmark area.
findings.why: It looks crowded and makes the controls harder to scan quickly on my phone.

findings.title: The final story sentence is incomplete
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Aarav looked up at the sky, he would always remember”
findings.why: That is the last line of the birthday present, and it reads as unfinished. I wouldn’t want to give Aarav a book that ends like that.

findings.title: Generated title contains a spelling error
findings.evidence: “The Magical Adventrue of Aarav”
findings.why: A spelling mistake in the title makes the personalised present look less special.

findings.title: Premium gift wrap is pre-selected
findings.evidence: [6] checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked) — £7.99
findings.why: I’m price-conscious and dislike paying £7.99 for something I did not choose. It makes the checkout feel manipulative.

findings.title: Artificial reservation countdown
findings.evidence: Your price is reserved for 09:57
findings.why: A countdown adds pressure, and it’s unclear whether the price genuinely changes or this is only a sales tactic.

findings.title: Navigation wraps awkwardly on a phone
findings.evidence: The header visibly splits “How it works,” “My books,” and “Log out” across awkward lines.
findings.why: It looks messy and makes the small links harder to scan with one thumb.

findings.title: Gift-wrap checkbox is detached from its label
findings.evidence: The empty checkbox for [6] appears by itself above “Premium gift wrap” and “£7.99”.
findings.why: On a phone it is less obvious which charge the checkbox controls, especially as the pre-selected charge was already annoying.

findings.title: The price-reservation message is ambiguous
findings.evidence: “Your price is reserved for 09:45” is shown without explaining whether that is a countdown, a clock time, or how long the price is held.
findings.why: I might mistake this for urgency and rush into buying, which is exactly what I do not want.

findings.title: coherence

findings.title: fidelity
